title: Isometric Design
slide_intent: Relate a modular form to shared creation so viewers can understand how separate contributions become a whole.
strategic_value: The repeated diamond can connect Dropbox’s platform role with its collaboration story.
demonstration: Two gray panels isolate the lower diamond in blue at left and the upper four in blue at right; orange annotations explain platform and expansion.
practical_value: Separate an identity’s foundational unit from the arrangement that expresses growth.

content_islands.name: Expansion
content_islands.spec: Highlight the upper four diamonds in the right panel and retain the outward orange arrows.
